searchTools:
**Keyword Strategy:** - ACTION VERB + ENTITY: "create post", "upload image", "search page", "update section" - Variants auto-match: "uploading" → "upload", "images" → "image" - BATCH all task needs: "create post upload image publish section hero"
**Search Behavior:** - First search: Use 8+ diverse keywords covering entities, actions, content types - Evaluate results: Do found tools match your task? Check tool names carefully - If tools don't match OR task needs more capabilities → search again with DIFFERENT keywords - Max 3 search attempts, then ask user for clarification
**Retry Strategy:** - Wrong tools found: Broaden scope, try synonyms, add entity types - First: "create post" → Second: "add new article content publish draft" - No tools found: Try related concepts, alternative verbs - First: "hero banner" → Second: "section header image update content"
**Anti-patterns:** - Using tools that don't match task just because they were found - Stopping after first search when results are clearly wrong - Repeating same keywords hoping for different results
